package_info.why_malicious: The script was surreptitiously injected into the Morfix online dictionary website via an advertisement network, causing users' browsers to mine cryptocurrency without their knowledge or consent. This results in unauthorized resource usage and potential performance degradation for users.

execution_context.file_location: Injected into the website via advertisement network (likely in the HTML or loaded JavaScript)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code loads a remote JavaScript library for cryptocurrency mining, starts mining using the user's CPU, and sends mined hashes to a remote server controlled by the mining service, resulting in unauthorized resource consumption and potential profit for the attacker.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code executes cryptocurrency mining in the user's browser without notification or consent, hijacking CPU resources for the attacker's benefit.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal website advertisements or scripts should not perform intensive background computations or use the user's device for mining cryptocurrency.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some websites may transparently offer mining as an alternative to ads, but only with clear user consent and notification.
key_indicators: Inclusion of known mining libraries (e.g., CoinHive)
Automatic mining start on page load

attack_chain.action: Malicious mining script is injected into the website via an advertisement network.
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of mining code in users' browsers

attack_chain.action: When a user visits the website, the mining script executes in their browser, hijacking CPU resources.
attack_chain.leads_to: Continuous mining activity and exfiltration of mining results to attacker's server

behavioral_signatures: Web pages loading known crypto-mining JavaScript libraries (e.g., CoinHive, Crypto-Loot)
Unexpected high CPU usage in browser tabs
JavaScript code that starts mining operations without user interaction
file_indicators: Presence of <script src="https://coinhive.com/lib/coinhive.min.js"> or similar mining library URLs
Inline JavaScript invoking mining functions (e.g., CoinHive.Anonymous, miner.start())
network_indicators: Outbound connections to known mining pool domains (e.g., coinhive.com, cryptoloot.pro)
Frequent small POST/GET requests to mining service endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor web traffic for inclusion of known mining scripts, analyze JavaScript for mining-related function calls, and alert on browser tabs exhibiting sustained high CPU usage. Network monitoring can detect connections to mining pool domains. Web application firewalls or browser extensions can block or alert on mining script inclusion.
